draw_exposure.note: ~1,970 deposit rows per 24 h fleet-wide (10-03); compost runs at town.

exposure.note: Ready = >= 3 canary compost visits AND >= 1 control bot at >= 34 slots holding junk (57 in the dry run 10-04 00:10Z). A composter must be built first in each canary town, so exposure may take hours.

own_lines.note: C1: composted something that is not junk or a sapling (food, logs, ores, tools).
C2: composted saplings and ended below the 16 reserve.
C3: more than one composter built in a canary town.
C4: a build row with free < need.
C5: more than one visit left bone meal uncollected (sandbox 0/6).
POSITIVE CONTROL: the population (full bots holding junk) exists on the control. BLOCKS KEEP.

primary.note: REPORTED, NOT GATED: compostable-junk slots per bot DiD, share of bots at >= 34 slots DiD, slots freed per compost visit.

harm.note: Unchanged: the two-death floor (OWNER 2026-09-11) and gather_ratio < 0.43 of control, from immobiledid. Watch _reflex_stuck during visits (window exempts only the visit).

teardown.note: THREE STEPS: drop-ins, clear canary_pool, restart the pool's bots 12 s apart; then confirm the live versions. A built composter STAYS in the world (bots built it; not an admin edit).
